node.title: C36' fifth product-orbit moment compiler
node.statement: Let U(t)=(P(t)+D(t))/2 be the number of unordered product representations and M_5^rich=sum_{t!=1,P(t)>=19}binom(U(t),5)R(t). Then X_18<=(2/231)M_5^rich, with sharp compiler equality at (P,D,U)=(22,0,11). Consequently M_5^rich<=(34650/17)n^2 implies the critical target 17X_18<=300n^2. The reduction is proved; the moment estimate is not claimed.
